name: dsh

detect.detect_notes: Install shape verified 2026-09-10 on this machine: NO PATH shim (`where dsh` finds nothing) and NOT an npm-global layout (`<npm-root>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai` absent), so detect.npm_exe/npm_entry do not apply. The launcher is a Node script under the dsh profile home: ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js (the retired external-agent-suite dsh adapter's legacyLauncherPath (archived 2026-09-12); a PATH hit would risk binding the wrong binary class, adapter r1 fix 3) — this per-user conventional location is now auto-probed via known_paths. Repair when absent: set endpoints.overrides.dsh.bin in config.json to that JS bundle — spawn.ts wraps .js via process.execPath. `node <bin.js> --version` prints `0.1.2-rc.1` (verified 2026-09-10).

command.argv_notes: Headless CLI surface (verified live 2026-09-10 via `<bin> --help` and `--profile headless --help` on 0.1.2-rc.1): `dsh --profile headless [task...]` — the task is the final positional argv value and MULTIPLE positionals are joined into the task text, so paidan declares NO mode_args/model_arg/add_dir_arg: any spliced fragment would silently become prompt content. There are no headless flags for model, permission, or a total timeout (probe report 2026-09-09 eight-agent §6: `--profile`, `--patch` only). Model is profile-selected (settings.yaml agent-default-model); permission is the process-level DSH_PERMISSION_MODE fallback. paidan never passes --patch: the suite's guard patch (cordis.patch.yml hook-external-agent-guard) is retired by decision, and the foreground-settlement patch is suite-managed, not paidan's to ship — see capabilities notes.
command.mode_env_notes: Per-preset env splicing (added 2026-09-10) unlocks the read-only tier: DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=read-only is injected only for --mode read-only runs, via ENV not argv — safe against the dsh headless multi-positional trap (any extra argv fragment would be joined into the prompt text; argv_notes). The base profile reads DSH_PERMISSION_MODE at boot as the process-level permission fallback (dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml: mode: process.env.DSH_PERMISSION_MODE ?? 'workspace-write', approval ask unless danger-full-access).

env._env_notes: native_default = paidan does not set the variable (dsh runs against the user's real ~/.dsh: profile, settings.yaml, credentials via apiKeyEnv references — paidan never stages or copies any of it, invariant 3/4). DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 matches the suite runner's fixed pin (adapters/dsh.mjs buildProviderEnv). For --mode read-only runs mode_env injects DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=read-only per run (mode_env_notes); for other modes a caller-exported DSH_PERMISSION_MODE still applies verbatim — see permission.presets_notes.

fs.read.via: workspace-write sandbox tier (native default) allows local reads; suite contract capabilities.local_read=true

fs.write.via: workspace-write sandbox tier (dsh-base cordis.patch.yml sandbox-policy default when DSH_PERMISSION_MODE is unset): writes confined to the workspace + temp roots (probe report 2026-09-09 §2); live paidan write run verified 2026-09-10

shell.exec.via: headless profile ships bash/pwsh tools; workspace-write+ask runs them foreground, escalation-dependent calls fail closed with no answerer (suite contract capabilities.tests_and_commands=true, 2026-08-21 canary)

net.fetch.via: headless ships web_fetch enabled by default since 0.1.2-rc.1 (probe report 2026-09-09 §5); not covered by paidan P1-P3 probes

interact.ask.via: headless has no approval channel: approval policy ask fails closed (`sandbox escalation ... requires approval, but no approval channel is available`, suite P2 run 466b67d9, re-verified raw on 0.1.2-rc.1 2026-09-10)

permission.presets_notes: workspace-write = native default tier (no env needed). read-only = DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=read-only injected per run via command.mode_env (env, not argv — the headless positional trap makes argv splicing unsafe): the NATIVE sandbox read-only tier is verified (suite P2 run 466b67d9 2026-09-09: write denied, escalation fail-closed, exit 0; re-verified raw with DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=read-only on 0.1.2-rc.1 2026-09-10; dsh task bare-layer evidence: file not created + sandbox refusal observable). unattended: danger-full-access is deliberately not exposed headless (suite contract required_invocation.task_mode_rule) and there is no approval channel. Probe consequence: P2 runs the live read-only path, P1/P3 tier is workspace-write.

denial_evidence.via: sandbox/approval refusals exit 0 and surface in the final text (stdout) with tool-emitted signatures `file access denied under read-only mode` (with or without the `[sandbox: ...]` bracket prefix) and `requires approval, but no approval channel is available`; the parser flags them in-band, detectRefusals covers stderr leakage (suite P2 run 466b67d9 + raw re-verification 2026-09-10)

resume.notes: The headless surface returns NO session handle: every run is a fresh Agent by design (suite contract session.supported=false; probe report 2026-09-09 §3: headless 无句柄). The core API ctx.agents.resume exists since 0.1.2-rc.1 and 0.1.3-alpha adds a core-level session lock (same session, at most one process), but neither is exposed on the headless CLI. The 2026-08-26 no-resume decision stands for the headless face. paidan P3 skips on kind!=flag.

models.notes: v0: heuristic read of the native $DSH_HOME|~/.dsh/settings.yaml `agent-default-model` block (provider/model/reasoningEffort); dsh is profile-only — no CLI model-list surface and no headless model flag. Credentials are apiKeyEnv references inside settings.yaml; paidan reads names only, never values (invariant 3). Selection = native profile default; no cross-connection fallback.

parser_notes: dsh headless emits PLAIN TEXT on stdout (the final assistant message; adapter extractFacts: final = stdout.trim()) and streams reasoning to stderr as `dsh: reasoning:` blocks. No structured events, no session handle, no usage rows (adapter: provider_reports_no_usage -> usage null, source unavailable). A plain-text stream has no structure to violate, so the parser never sets degraded; an empty final is terminal judgment's business. Refusal evidence is in-band in the final text (see permission.denial_evidence).

capabilities.capabilities_notes: Stock headless waits only for the root Agent to become idle; subagent/shell background routes CAN outlive the root turn (why the suite ships the foreground-settlement patch). paidan does not inject that patch, so background_native is false and tasks that force background subagents may exit with descendants pending — keep tasks foreground-shaped.
